name: Imagineering Technologies
summary: Melbourne hosting provider (co-location, VPS, web/mail hosting) co-founded 1997 by Matthew Proctor (ex-Tangent Internet); grew from first hosting customer to full data centre business; acquired by Primus Telecommunications (Australia) Sep 2008.

events.details: Imagineering Technologies Pty Ltd co-founded 1997 by Matthew Proctor immediately after folding his Tangent Internet ISP operations into the venture. Grew into a full-service Melbourne data centre business serving SMB and corporate clients. Earliest verified Wayback capture of imagineering.com.au is 6 Jul 2000.

refs.label: Matthew Proctor: CEO & Co-Founder, Imagineering Technologies Pty Ltd (founded 1997)
Wayback Machine: earliest capture of imagineering.com.au (6 Jul 2000)

events.details: Acquired by Primus Telecommunications (Australia); Imagineering press release dated 8 Sep 2008. 'Imagineering Data Centre' continued as a registered business name of Primus Telecommunications (Australia) Pty Ltd (ACN 061 754 943) from 9 Sep 2008 until 20 Jan 2021.
